items.originalTitle: Las Vegas GP reveals neon-inspired trophy for 2026
detailZh: 拉斯维加斯大奖赛为2026年的F1赛事揭晓了一款新奖杯，其设计灵感来源于城市标志性的霓虹灯牌和复古照明招牌。
这款奖杯是自该赛事于2023年加入F1赛历以来使用的第二个设计，其独特的V型轮廓代表着拉斯维加斯和胜利。
然而，社交媒体上的粉丝迅速提出了V型设计的第三种含义：‘V代表维斯塔潘’，开玩笑说这个奖杯可能是为红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘量身定做的。
其设计借鉴了与著名弗里蒙特街传统上相关的霓虹灯和白炽灯招牌，这个概念旨在让赛事获胜者拥有自己的照明拉斯维加斯标志。
冠军奖杯高22英寸，宽8¼英寸，重8磅（3.6千克），由实心复合材料制成，并镀有铜和铬。它还配备了122个独立灯光，并有一个五英尺的周界灯光。
该设计由拉斯维加斯大奖赛与Bowen Studios和Ore Designs合作开发。Bowen Studios负责奖杯的3D模型、渲染和动画，而Ore Designs，由Shane Larson领导，负责设计和制造实体奖杯。
Bowen Studios和Ore Designs之前曾合作开发了2023年至2025年的拉斯维加斯大奖赛奖杯，以及过去两年的美国大奖赛奖杯。
detailEn: The Las Vegas Grand Prix has unveiled a new trophy for its 2026 Formula 1 race, with a design inspired by the city's iconic neon signs and vintage illuminated marquees.
The trophy is the second design used since the event joined the F1 calendar in 2023 and features a distinctive V-shaped silhouette, representing both Vegas and victory.
However, fans on social media were quick to suggest a third meaning behind the V-shaped design: 'V for Verstappen', joking that the trophy could be tailor-made for Red Bull's Max Verstappen.

Its design draws on the neon and incandescent-bulb signage traditionally associated with the famous Fremont Street, with the concept intended to give the race winner their own illuminated Las Vegas sign.

The winner's trophy measures 22 inches high and 8¼ inches wide, weighs 8lbs (3.6kg) and is made from solid composite with copper and chrome plating. Alongside its 122 individual lights, it features a five-foot perimeter light.

The design was developed by the Las Vegas Grand Prix in collaboration with Bowen Studios and Ore Designs. Bowen Studios was responsible for the trophy's 3D model, renderings and animations, while Ore Designs, led by Shane Larson, engineered and fabricated the physical trophies.
Bowen Studios and Ore Designs previously worked together on the Las Vegas Grand Prix trophies from 2023 to 2025, as well as the past two United States Grand Prix trophies.

items.originalTitle: Christian Horner reveals how Max Verstappen’s management reshaped 2022 Red Bull development
items.summaryEn: Former Red Bull team boss Christian Horner revealed that Max Verstappen's management demanded the team shift its 2022 car development away from Sergio Perez.
detailZh: 克里斯蒂安·霍纳揭示马克斯·维斯塔潘的管理团队如何改变了红牛2022年的研发方向
前红牛负责人克里斯蒂安·霍纳透露，马克斯·维斯塔潘的管理团队要求车队将2022年赛车研发方向从塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯身上转移开
马克斯·维斯塔潘、红牛车队、塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯、红牛车队
致红牛车迷。关注红牛车队，获取来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术洞察与比赛分析。
关于塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯在红牛车队效力期间的叙述，往往集中在他无法持续展现出与队友马克斯·维斯塔潘相同的原始速度上。但红牛车队前首席执行官兼领队克里斯蒂安·霍纳最近揭开了幕后工程之争的帷幕，这场争斗改变了佩雷斯2022赛季的轨迹。
霍纳在《高性能》播客中谈到他在米尔顿凯恩斯车队执掌二十年的经历时透露，2022年的初始底盘小红牛18并非天生按照维斯塔潘的极端偏好打造。相反，这辆早期地面效应赛车是2021年全年由当时的储备车手亚历克斯·阿尔本在模拟器中开发的，结果是一台更平衡、更可预测的机器。
“亚历克斯·阿尔本在幕后开发22款赛车方面做了了不起的工作……那非常符合他的驾驶风格，这是一种更经典的驾驶方式，可能更接近塞尔吉奥或丹尼尔（里卡多），”霍纳解释道。
由于2022年的初始赛车拥有可预测的车头，并且缺乏维斯塔潘偏好的那种极端、突然的旋转，佩雷斯一上来就表现出色。
霍纳指出：“当我们开始2022赛季时，如果你还记得，马克斯讨厌那辆车，车有太多转向不足，而塞尔吉奥凭借那种可预测性……突然间他们各自赢得了一场比赛，”他指的是年初两人激烈的竞争。
但内部均势是短暂的。意识到（当时的）卫冕世界冠军难以最大化一辆为传统驾驶风格调校的赛车，维斯塔潘的管理团队介入，迫使进行重大技术转向。
霍纳确认，在2022年阿塞拜疆大奖赛周末期间发生了一次直接对峙。
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯，红牛车队
霍纳透露：“我记得那年阿塞拜疆站前后，我和马克斯的经纪团队坐下来谈，他们对我说：‘你看，你是围绕佩雷兹来开发这辆车的；你需要去顺应马克斯的需求。’”
面对这位当家车手阵营发出的最后通牒，红牛的工程部门决定调整研发方向。霍纳承认，车队优先考虑了这位“核心资产”的需求，因为维斯塔潘终究拥有更高的性能上限。
霍纳承认：“马克斯是核心资产，他是你最有希望用来赢下车手的车手……当然，任何工程团队都会自然而然地倾向于他们最快的车手。”
随着红牛对小红牛18进行研发，消除转向不足并引入更锐利、响应更灵敏的车头，维斯塔潘的速度爆发了。反过来，这条研发路径也剥夺了佩雷兹所习惯的可预测性，导致两位车手之间出现了巨大的性能差距。
detailEn: Christian Horner reveals how Max Verstappen’s management reshaped 2022 Red Bull development
Former Red Bull boss Christian Horner reveals Max Verstappen's management demanded the team shift its 2022 car development away from Sergio Perez
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Sergio Perez, Red Bull Racing
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

The narrative surrounding Sergio Perez's tenure at Red Bull Racing often centres on his inability to consistently extract the same raw pace as his team-mate Max Verstappen. But former Red Bull Racing CEO and team principal Christian Horner recently pulled back the curtain on a behind-the-scenes engineering battle that altered the trajectory of Perez's 2022 season.

Speaking on the High Performance podcast about his two-decade stint at the helm of the Milton Keynes squad, Horner revealed that the initial 2022 chassis, the RB18, was not inherently built to Verstappen's extreme preferences. Instead, the early ground-effect car was developed in the simulator by then-reserve driver Alex Albon throughout 2021, resulting in a more balanced, predictable machine.

"Alex Albon did a hell of a job in the background developing the '22 car... it was very much around his style of driving, which [is a] much more classic way of driving that was probably more akin to a Sergio or a Daniel [Ricciardo]," Horner explained.
Because the initial 2022 car possessed a predictable front end and lacked the extreme, snappy rotation that Verstappen prefers, Perez thrived right out of the gate.

"When we started the '22 season, if you remember that Max hated the car, it had too much understeer in the car, and Sergio with that predictability... suddenly they were winning a race apiece," Horner noted, referencing their close fight at the start of the year.

But the internal parity was short-lived. Recognising that the (then) reigning world champion was struggling to maximise a car geared toward a traditional driving style, Verstappen's management team stepped in to force a major technical pivot.
Horner confirmed that a direct confrontation occurred during the 2022 Azerbaijan Grand Prix weekend.
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Sergio Perez, Red Bull Racing
"I remember sitting down with Max's management around Azerbaijan that year and them saying, 'Look, you've developed this car around Checo; you need to be following what Max needs,'" Horner revealed.

Faced with an ultimatum from the camp of its franchise driver, Red Bull's engineering department made the decision to shift its development path. Horner admitted that the team prioritised the demands of its "prime asset" because Verstappen ultimately possessed the higher performance ceiling.
"Max is the prime asset, he's the driver you're most likely going to win with... of course any engineering team will gravitate just naturally towards their fastest driver," Horner admitted.

As Red Bull developed the RB18 to strip away the understeer and introduce a sharper, more responsive front end, Verstappen's pace exploded. Conversely, the development path stripped away the predictability that Perez was used to, leading to a massive performance delta between the two drivers.

items.summaryEn: Mercedes technical director James Allison has revealed that during the team's four-year title drought he told hundreds of new staff members that they would one day win and claim the championship as their own.
detailZh: 詹姆斯·阿利森透露梅赛德斯四年F1冠军荒期间对新员工的寄语
阿利森告诉数百名新员工，他们终将赢得比赛，并把世界冠军收入囊中
致梅赛德斯车迷。关于银箭车队的最新消息，包括来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发和比赛分析。
梅赛德斯技术总监詹姆斯·阿利森透露，在车队成绩低迷的几年里，他曾告诉数百名加入布拉克利车队的员工，他们终将赢得比赛，并夺得属于自己的世界冠军。
梅赛德斯在2014年至2021年间连续八次赢得车队总冠军，但随后四个赛季无缘冠军，直到2026年才重新包揽两项桂冠，基米·安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛成为最年轻的世界冠军，而车队一周后在巴西大奖赛锁定车队总冠军。
阿利森在NU银箭电台节目中表示，他在2023年注意到，许多自车队上次夺冠以来加入的人感到运气不佳。
“我感觉到，2021年之后、也就是我们上一次夺冠之后加入车队的约400人，看起来有点自怜，他们加入时以为是一支常胜之师，结果发现自己来得正是时候不巧，”这位英国人解释道。
随后，他在面向全厂的讲话中直接对这群人说了话。
“你们不是运气不好；你们是这家工厂里最幸运的人，因为我们将再次获胜，”他告诉他们。“而且你们知道，当我们做到时，你们全程都在那里。这不是你们蹭来的别人的冠军——是你们亲手打造的。你们将永远能够称它为你们自己的。这是你们的派对。”
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯；安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯
艾利森表示，该群体此后已增长到“600人以上”，并认为因此这个冠军对他们来说意义更加重大。
“那些人知道，这个冠军是他们从一开始就在场并亲手造就的。那是一种特别强烈的感受，”他补充道。
艾利森强调，这一成功在很大程度上要归功于那些从不去比赛现场的员工。他表示，梅赛德斯在其布拉克利底盘基地和布里克斯沃思引擎工厂共有“约2000名”员工。
他解释道：“车队中约有8%的人参与外出比赛，而让这一切成为可能、创造圈速并交付所有这些成果、使我们最前端的车手能够真正加以利用的绝大部分工作，都发生在这座工厂里。”
detailEn: James Allison reveals message to Mercedes recruits during team's four-year F1 title drought
Allison told hundreds of new employees they would eventually win and claim the championship as their own
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

Mercedes technical director James Allison has revealed how he told hundreds of staff members who joined the Brackley outfit during the team's lean years that they would one day win, and that the championship would be theirs.

Mercedes won eight consecutive constructors' titles between 2014 and 2021, but then went four seasons without a championship before claiming both crowns in 2026, with Kimi Antonelli becoming the youngest champion at the Mexican Grand Prix and the team securing the constructors' crown at the Brazilian Grand Prix a week later.
Speaking on the NU Silver Arrows Radio Show, Allison said he noticed in 2023 that many of the people who had joined since the team's last title were feeling unlucky.

"I got a sense that the 400 or so people who joined the team after 2021, the last time previously we'd won, were looking a bit sorry for themselves, having joined what they thought was a winning juggernaut, only to find that they'd arrived at just the wrong moment," the Briton explained.
He then addressed that group directly in a talk to the whole factory.

"You are not unlucky; you're the luckiest people in this factory, because we are going to win again," he told them. "And you know that when we do, you were there for the whole of that. It isn't someone else's championship that you've glommed on to - you built it. And you'll always be able to call it your own. It's your party."
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
Allison said that group has since grown to "something upwards of 600" people, and believes the title means even more to them as a result.
"Those people know that this championship is something that they were there for from the start and made their own. And that is a particularly powerful feeling," he added.
Allison was keen to stress how much of the success is down to staff who never go to races. He said Mercedes has "about 2,000" people across its Brackley chassis base and Brixworth engine factory.

"About 8% of the team do the travelling part, and the vast majority of what makes it all possible - what creates the lap time and delivers all this stuff so that the tip of our spear can actually use it - is back here in the factory," he explained.

items.originalTitle: Haas sticks with Rafael Camara for Las Vegas, Ryo Hirakawa in for FP1
detailZh: 哈斯车队决定在拉斯维加斯站继续留用拉斐尔·卡马拉
新手车手卡马拉将获得另一个机会为2027年的完整F1首秀做准备
拉斐尔·卡马拉将在即将到来的拉斯维加斯大奖赛中再次为哈斯车队参赛，而平田翔太将取代奥利·贝尔曼在首场练习赛中的位置
在墨西哥城大奖赛周末期间被解雇的埃斯特班·奥康被解雇后，平田翔太和卡马拉都已为车队参赛
Hirakawa在摩纳哥参加世界耐力锦标赛决赛——后来赢得了他的第三个WEC冠军——因此无法参加之前在巴西的F1赛事，这给了哈斯车队一个机会，让Camara提前亮相。
Camara将留在赛车中参加拉斯维加斯的比赛，为他为车队在下一赛季的全职F1首秀积累宝贵经验。与此同时，贝尔曼今年至今只为一个FP1赛段让出了座位，因此他将最后一次让出座位，以便给Hirakawa在VF-26赛车中获得更多赛道时间。
Hirakawa在墨西哥城的F1首秀中获得了积分，尽管在奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里和两位阿尔卑斯车手被处以赛后罚分之后，他给车队总监小松洋雄留下了“非常好的心理素质——[他]非常干净。他做到了我们期望的。”的印象。
Camara的处子秀更加艰难，因为圣保罗赛道（Interlagos）的天气条件极其多变。这位巴西人在周末逐渐提升状态，FP3结束时展现出了良好的速度，但雨在排位赛之前到来，使他的生活变得更加困难。
在Q1从打滑中挽救了自己的赛车后，卡马拉进入了Q2，但在12号弯道由于在低抓地力条件下无法正确调整后轴制动，导致赛车撞上了墙壁。
因此，他获得了第13个发车位，但由于其他车手受到发车位处罚，他实际上从第11位起步，但在中雨轮胎的艰难比赛中，卡马拉几乎掉到了车队的最后。
鉴于卡马拉在F2车手积分榜上的位置，他是否会留在车队参加剩余赛季还不确定；他可能希望完成本赛季，但这将很大程度上取决于哈斯车队和法拉利的决定。
如果卡马拉决定参加卡塔尔和阿布扎比的赛事，那么伊拉卡瓦可以在这些比赛中重返赛车。
detailEn: Haas sticks with Rafael Camara for Las Vegas, Ryo Hirakawa in for FP1
Rookie driver Camara gets another chance to prepare for his full F1 debut in 2027
Rafael Camara will race again for Haas at Formula 1's upcoming Las Vegas Grand Prix, as Ryo Hirakawa takes Ollie Bearman's seat for the opening practice session.
Both Hirakawa and Camara have now raced for the team following the dismissal of Esteban Ocon, who was stood down during the Mexico City Grand Prix weekend.

Hirakawa, contesting the World Endurance Championship finale in Monza - later winning his third WEC title - was unavailable for the previous F1 round in Brazil and this presented Haas an opportunity to bring Camara in for an early debut.

Camara will stay in the car for Las Vegas, as he gathers valuable experience for his full F1 debut next season with the team. Bearman meanwhile has only given up his seat for one FP1 session so far this year, so will do so for the final time to present Hirakawa with more track time in the VF-26.

Hirakawa scored a point in his Mexico City F1 debut, albeit after Oscar Piastri and the two Alpine drivers were handed post-race penalties, and impressed team principal Ayao Komatsu with "very good mental conviction - [he was] so clean. He delivered what we expected."

Camara endured a tougher debut run, as conditions at Interlagos were incredibly variable. The Brazilian built up through the weekend and showed good pace by the end of FP3, but the rain arrived ahead of qualifying and made his life more difficult.
After rescuing his car from a spin in Q1, Camara got as far as Q2 - but put his car into the wall at Turn 12 having been unable to get the correct rear-axle braking in low-grip conditions.
He thus qualified 13th and started 11th with other drivers taking grid penalties, but a tough stint on the intermediates put Camara towards the back of the field.

It is uncertain whether Camara will stay in the car for the rest of the season, given his position at the top of the F2 drivers' standings; he may wish to complete the season, but this will largely be at the behest of Haas and Ferrari.
Hirakawa could feasibly return to the car in Qatar and Abu Dhabi, should Camara return to F2 for those rounds.

Rafael Camara reacted to making his F1 debut with Haas during Friday's practice sessions in Sao Paulo.
Haas have confirmed that Rafael Camara will continue as Oliver Bearman's team-mate for this weekend's Las Vegas Grand Prix after making his Formula 1 debut last time out in Brazil.

The American-owned squad have been left with a vacant seat for the final five rounds of the season following a fall out between French driver Esteban Ocon and team boss Ayao Komatsu last month in Mexico.

Japanese driver Ryo Hirakawa, who had already featured in first practice in Mexico, drove in the Mexico City Grand Prix, before Camara, who had earlier in October been confirmed as Ocon's replacement at Haas for the 2027 season, was given the opportunity to make his debut at his home race in Sao Paulo.

items.originalTitle: Vegas gives Camara chance to put messy debut behind him
items.summaryEn: Haas has announced that new signing Rafael Camara will stay in the car for the Las Vegas Grand Prix, following his messy Formula 1 debut in Brazil.
detailZh: 哈斯新签下的拉斐尔·卡马拉将很快获得机会，摆脱他在巴西混乱的F1首秀，因为他将继续驾驶赛车出战本周末的拉斯维加斯大奖赛。
卡马拉的首秀因哈斯与埃斯特班·奥康戏剧性且突然的分手而从2027年提前，但最初的公告只确认卡马拉出战英特拉格斯。
如今哈斯宣布他将继续留在拉斯维加斯站，而曾在墨西哥大奖赛周末中途顶替奥康的平川亮，将回到阵容中，在第一次自由练习中驾驶奥利·贝尔曼的赛车。
不过拉斯维加斯之后的情况可能更复杂，因为F1最后几站卡塔尔和阿布扎比同期也有F2比赛，而卡马拉目前以仅7分的优势领跑F2积分榜，领先红牛储备车手尼科拉·措洛夫。鉴于赛程安排，同一周末同时参加F2和F1实际上是不可能的。
卡马拉表示，他“期待在拉斯维加斯重新坐进赛车”，因为巴西站是一次“很好的学习经历”。
车队领队小松礼雄表示，卡马拉的首秀是在“极具挑战性的条件下”完成的，但他仍然“向我们和全世界展示了他为什么值得我们签下他，直到2027年”。
卡马拉在那场首秀周末中排名第20位，也就是最后一名，落后两圈。但考虑到在那场比赛之前他从未驾驶过2026年的哈斯赛车，再加上不断变化的天气条件，他面临着许多可以理解的不利因素。
就首秀周末而言，很难想象还有比拉斐尔·卡马拉所面对的更为艰难的处境了。
他直到本周初才被临时召入，此前从未驾驶过哈斯赛车或任何2026款F1赛车。这压力巨大且充满挑战，而天气预报也从未显示出对他有利的迹象。事实证明果然如此。
同样令人沮丧和鼓舞的是，卡马拉展现出了许多潜力的闪光点。他在排位赛中非常快，并让自己处于一个非常有利的位置，即便排位赛期间下了雨。如果他在艰难条件下首秀就闯入Q3，那也不会令人意外，那将是非常令人印象深刻的表现。
在大奖赛的干胎阶段，他与队友奥利·贝尔曼相比实际上表现不错：在两段软胎 阶段中平均每圈慢约十分之一秒。但需要注意的是，贝尔曼的比赛受到了影响，他有一段时间陷入了车流。卡马拉在比赛开始和结束时使用半雨胎的阶段特别弱：与软胎相比，这两段与贝尔曼的差距都大幅扩大。
他在排位赛中的两次失误无疑让他的信心受到了一些打击。第一次是水滑和车轮打滑的混合作用，导致赛车在雷塔奥波斯塔直道上失控甩尾。第二次是在12号弯洪考弯锁死轮胎——许多车手在那里都遇到了麻烦——随后相当猛烈地撞上了护栏。
他在比赛开始时没有过度推进是可以理解的。事实上，哈斯车队很可能鼓励他不要冒任何愚蠢的风险。因此他花了一段时间才慢慢进入状态并找到节奏，但当他找到节奏时，他的速度非常非常快。
如果他在最后阶段能有一段更强的中途跑（inter stint）会更好。但到那时已经没有什么可争取的了，他只需要把车安全带回，所以这一点可以理解。
在获得第20名、落后两圈完赛后，他的F1生涯只会从这里变得更好。这不仅仅是因为成绩在纸面上如此糟糕，还因为他在排位赛和大奖赛中展现出的真正潜力也时有闪现。
detailEn: Haas's new signing Rafael Camara will get a quick chance to move on from his messy Formula 1 debut in Brazil as he will stay in the car for this weekend's Las Vegas Grand Prix.
Camara's debut was brought forward from 2027 following Haas's dramatic and abrupt split with Esteban Ocon, but the original announcement only committed to Camara racing at Interlagos.
Now Haas has announced he will stay on for Vegas, with Ryo Hirakawa - who initially jumped in for Ocon mid-way through the Mexican GP weekend - back in the line-up for FP1 in Ollie Bearman's car.

The situation beyond Vegas may be more complicated though, as the final F1 rounds in Qatar and Abu Dhabi also have Formula 2 on the bill, and Camara currently leads the F2 standings by just seven points over Red Bull reserve Nikola Tsolov. It is effectively impossible to race in both F2 and F1 over the same weekend given the schedules.
Camara said he was "looking forward to getting back in the car in Las Vegas" as Brazil had been a "good learning experience".
Team principal Ayao Komatsu said Camara's debut had been in "extremely challenging conditions" but that he's still "showed us and the world why we signed him for 2027".

Camara ended that debut weekend 20th and last, two laps down. But having never driven the 2026 Haas before that event, and given the changing weather conditions, he faced plenty of mitigating factors.
As debut weekends go, it's hard to imagine tougher circumstances than the ones Rafael Camara faced.

He only got called up at the start of the week and hadn't driven the Haas or any 2026 F1 car before. This was high pressure and challenging, and the forecast never looked like it was going to be on his side. And so it proved.

What's probably equally frustrating and encouraging is that there were so many flashes of potential from Camara. He was very quick in qualifying and got himself into a really nice place, even with the rain that fell during the session. It would not have been a surprise if he'd snuck into Q3 on debut in tough conditions, which would have been very impressive.

In the slick running in the grand prix, he actually compared well to team-mate Ollie Bearman: about a tenth of a second a lap slower on average across two stints on softs. The caveat is that Bearman's race was compromised and he spent some time in traffic. Camara was particularly weak in the intermediate running at the start of the race and again at the end: the gap to Bearman ballooned in both of those stints compared with the softs.

His confidence was surely battered a little by his two offs in qualifying. The first was a mix of aquaplaning and wheelspin that sent the car fishtailing out of control down the Reta Oposta straight. The second was a lock-up at the Juncao Turn 12, where a lot of drivers had trouble, followed by a fairly heavy hit into the barrier.

You can forgive him for not over-pushing at the start of the race. In fact, Haas probably encouraged him not to take any silly risks. So it took a while for him to ease his way in and find his rhythm but, when he did, he was very, very quick.
It would have been better if he could have had a stronger inter stint at the end. But by that point there was nothing to play for and he just needed to bring it home, so you can understand that.

After finishing 20th and two laps down, his F1 career will only get better from here. That's not just because the result was so weak on paper but because the glimpses of his true potential throughout qualifying and the grand prix were there too.

items.originalTitle: F1 poised to take crucial step towards V8 engines' return
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 is set to take a major step forward on Monday toward the return of V8 engines, with manufacturers poised to back new power unit regulations. Sources suggest broad agreement among current carmakers on the shift toward cheaper, less complex and more fan-appealing engines, with a 2.1-litre V8 the idea set to be backed.
detailZh: F1转向V8引擎的计划将于周一迈出重要一步，各制造商准备支持新规则。
在国际汽联、车队和车手进行了数月讨论、就F1下一套规则方向收集反馈之后，一份关于新动力单元的正式提案将在管理机构与制造商的会议上讨论。
消息人士表示，F1当前各家汽车制造商对规则转向存在广泛共识，这些规则旨在确保未来引擎更便宜、更简单，并对车迷更具吸引力。
尽管规则的许多细节仍需微调，但总体而言，看起来将获得支持的想法是采用2.1升V8引擎。
这种配置将有助于最大限度地减少额外支出，因为它避免了需要所有全新的内燃机设计，这些设计可以通过在现有的1.6升V6发动机上增加两个气缸来创建。
V8发动机将配备一个更小的涡轮增压器，降低增压压力，以及一个比当前350千瓦更小的电动元件。
在这方面正在讨论的提议是使用200千瓦的电动机，但其中只有100千瓦始终可用。额外的100千瓦将用于超车或一键加速系统。
然而，并非所有提交给车队的提议都得到了支持，据了解，对于由外部供应商创建标准基线动力单元、然后允许制造商自行修改的想法存在阻力。
一位围场消息人士指出，制造商能否继续致力于F1的关键在于动力单元是否仍是性能差异化的因素。
虽然整体规则概念看起来将向前推进，但需要做出的重大决定是它何时进入F1。
现行规则计划执行到2030年底，这意味着V8引擎将在2031年引入。
然而，国际汽联主席穆罕默德·本·苏拉耶姆急于不等待那么久，并希望批准V8规则变更在2030年就发生。
本·苏拉耶姆上个月表示，他希望新规则能将引擎成本削减至目前水平的一半左右。
本·苏拉耶姆表示：“已经有很多文件发给车队领队和动力单元制造商，车手们也就此接受了咨询。”
“当你把它做得更简单时，就能把价格降到一半。然后如果研发成本减半，凭借这种简化，生产时间也可以更短。”
转向更简单的动力单元之际，也在推动大幅降低赛车重量——国际汽联的目标是让赛车比现在轻80公斤。
正如国际汽联单座赛车总监尼古拉斯·通巴西斯最近所说：“当我们列出购物清单并把所有项目加起来时，我们可以轻松降到700公斤以下。
“现在我们意识到，在讨论问题时，某些领域会有一些反弹。我们将不得不做出一些妥协。
“人们会担心某些成本，但总体而言，我们的目标是低于700公斤，我认为这将是让赛车更令人兴奋的重要一步。”
虽然继续使用涡轮增压意味着下一代V8发动机不会提供过去时代那种尖啸声浪，但涡轮增压的存在将避免可能需要重新引入加油环节。
Tombazis补充道：“总的来说，我们并不热衷于引入加油环节，而且我们也知道各车队对此并不热衷，”他说。
“这会增加一层复杂性和风险，但同样重要的是，它会让赛前的进站窗口变得明确得多。因此，这意味着根据你是否丢失了位置来调整策略的灵活性会大大降低。”
detailEn: Formula 1's plans to move to V8 engines is set for a major step forward on Monday, with manufacturers poised to back new regulations.

Following months of discussions between the FIA, teams and drivers to gather feedback on a direction for F1's next rules set, a formal proposal for the new power units is to be discussed at a gathering of the governing body and manufacturers.

Sources have suggested that there is broad agreement among F1's current carmakers over the shift of rules, which are aimed at ensuring future engines are cheaper, less complex and more appealing to fans.
Although many details of the regulations will still need finetuning, in broad terms the idea that looks set to be backed is for a 2.1-litre V8 engine.

This configuration will help minimise extra expenditure because it avoids the need for all new internal combustion engine designs, as they can be created by adding two cylinders on to the current 1.6-litre V6s.
The V8 will be accompanied by a smaller turbo with reduced boost pressure, as well as a smaller electrical element compared to the current 350kW.

The proposal being discussed on this front is for a 200kW electric motor, but with only 100kW of that available at all times. The extra 100kW would be used for either an overtake or push-to-pass system.

Not all the proposals put in front of teams have been supported though, with it understood there is resistance to one idea for a standard baseline power unit being created by an external supplier, which manufacturers would then be allowed to modify themselves.
One paddock source suggested that critical for manufacturers to continue to commit to F1 is that the power unit remains a performance differentiator.
While the overall rules concept looks like it will move forward, the big decision that needs to be made is when it will arrive in F1.
The current regulations are planned to run through to the end of 2030, meaning the V8s would then come in for 2031.
However, FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem is eager to not wait that long and is hoping to sign off for the V8 rule shift to happen in 2030 itself.
Speaking last month, Ben Sulayem said he hoped that the new rules would cut engine costs to around half of their current level.
"There have been a lot of papers with the team principals and power unit manufacturers, plus the drivers have been consulted about it," said Ben Sulayem.
"When you make it simpler, you can make it half of the price. Then if the R&D goes down by half, with the simplicity the production time can be shorter."
The move to simpler power units will also come amid a push to reduce car weight dramatically – with the FIA targeting cars that are 80kg lighter than now.
As the FIA's single seater director Nikolas Tombazis said recently: "When we do the shopping list and add everything up, we can get quite comfortably below 700kg.
"Now we are conscious that when we discuss things, there will be some kickback in some areas. We'll have to compromise a bit.
"There will be concerns about certain costs, but overall our target is to be below 700kg, and I think it will be a significant step to make the cars more exciting."
While the continued use of a turbo means the next V8s won't offer the screaming sound of previous eras, the turbo's presence will avoid the need for a potential return of refuelling.
Tombazis added: "Generally [we are] not keen to go to refuelling and we also know the teams are not keen to go to refuelling," he said.

"It adds a level of complexity and risk, but also importantly, it makes the pitstop windows far more defined before the race. So it means that there's much less flexibility to adapt to your strategy depending on whether you've lost positions or not."

detailZh: 克里斯蒂安·霍纳承认红牛车队在对抗马克斯·维斯塔潘时过早地投入了年轻车手

对于红牛车队的粉丝来说，关注红牛车队，了解F1新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和米尔顿凯恩斯的比赛分析
红牛车队的第二个席位长期以来一直被视为一级方程式中最具压力的环境之一。当米尔顿凯恩斯的运营频繁地更换被高度评价的年轻车手，试图为马克斯·维斯塔潘找到合适的搭档时，前车队经理克里斯蒂安·霍纳现在公开质疑这种无情的车手培养体系的逻辑。
在《高性能播客》中，霍纳回顾了他管理车队的日子，并承认他经常不同意将车手迅速投入到与一代天才对抗的深水区。
“有些车手来得太早了，我并不完全同意他们进入红牛车队的速度，但红牛青训车队中有他们的决心，”霍纳透露。
霍纳将皮埃尔·加斯利、亚历克斯·阿隆和利亚姆·劳森列为过早晋升到高级别座位的潜在例子。
这种发展失败的例子之一是皮埃尔·加斯利在2019年与高级车队短暂的任职。在仅仅在姐妹车队托罗罗索（现更名为小红牛）度过一个完整赛季后，加斯利难以适应高度敏感的红牛底盘和维斯塔潘原始速度带来的巨大压力。
Horner回忆起球队观看法国车手信心崩溃的准确时刻。在那年的奥地利大奖赛和匈牙利大奖赛中，维斯塔潘的速度如此之快，以至于他在赛道上连续两次将加斯利甩在身后。
“你可以明显地看到他们感受到了那种压力，无论是皮埃尔，我记得他在奥地利和匈牙利大奖赛中连续两场比赛被超越，他在那些比赛中已经崩溃了，”Horner表示。
匈牙利大奖赛之后，红牛队突然将加斯利降级回小红牛队，直到赛季结束，并用阿隆索取代了他。
尽管Horner指出红牛体系通常通过允许车手返回青训车队而不是完全解雇他们来提供“降落伞”，但他并没有回避批评环境的残酷现实。
“一方面，红牛所做的是非常慷慨的，但就其执行方式而言，你曾是当月的宠儿，直到你不再是，”霍纳总结道。
detailEn: Christian Horner admits Red Bull prospects were thrown in against Max Verstappen too soon
Former Red Bull boss Christian Horner says the team's "brutal" promotion system mentally broke Pierre Gasly in 2019
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

The second seat at Red Bull Racing has long been viewed as one of the most high-pressure environments in Formula 1. While the Milton Keynes operation frequently cycled through highly rated prospects trying to find a match for Max Verstappen, former team principal Christian Horner is now openly questioning the logic of that ruthless driver pipeline.

Speaking on the High Performance podcast, Horner reflected on his tenure managing the team and admitted that he frequently disagreed with how quickly drivers were thrown into the deep end against a generational talent.

"Some of these drivers were arriving too soon, and I didn't completely agree with the speed at which they were arriving into Red Bull Racing, but there was a determination to have them from the Red Bull Junior pool," Horner revealed.
Horner named Pierre Gasly, Alex Albon, and Liam Lawson as prime examples of prospects who were rushed into the senior seat before they were properly prepared.

One example of this developmental failure was Pierre Gasly's short-lived stint with the senior team in 2019. Promoted after just one full season at sister outfit Toro Rosso (now Racing Bulls), Gasly struggled to adapt to the highly sensitive Red Bull chassis and the immense pressure of Verstappen's raw pace.

Horner recalled the exact moment the team watched the French driver's confidence collapse. During both the Austrian and Hungarian Grand Prix that year, Verstappen's pace was so blisteringly fast that he lapped Gasly on track.

"You could visibly see that they were feeling that pressure, whether it was Pierre, I remember [him] getting lapped in Austria and at the Hungarian Grand Prix two races in a row, and he was broken in those races," Horner stated.
Immediately following the Hungarian Grand Prix, Red Bull abruptly demoted Gasly back to Toro Rosso for the remainder of the season, replacing him with Albon.

While Horner noted that the Red Bull system usually provided a "parachute" by allowing drivers to return to the junior team rather than firing them completely, he did not shy away from criticising the harsh reality of the environment.
"It was, on the one hand, hugely generous what Red Bull were doing, but it was quite brutal in terms of its execution that you were the flavour of the month until you weren't," Horner concluded.

keyPointsEn: Horner openly questions the logic of the ruthless driver pipeline

detailZh: Topps展示评级为Gem Mint 10的兰多·诺里斯可口可乐战袍补丁卡
这张2024 Dynasty签名卡在诺里斯签名下方嵌有两块比赛服布料
致迈凯伦车迷。来自沃金的木瓜色新闻，包括车手、赛车、车队策略以及每个比赛周末的最新动态。
Topps公布了一张极为稀有的兰多·诺里斯卡片：一张2024 Dynasty系列F1签名卡，嵌有两块比赛服布料，其中一块取自其迈凯伦赛车服袖口上的可口可乐标志。
Topps Racing 账号周五在 Instagram 上发布了一段这张卡片的短视频，配文是“这张兰多·诺里斯补丁签名卡简直疯了！”
这张卡片来自 Single Driver Dual Relic Autograph 系列。诺里斯的签名下方有两个红色布料窗口。左边那块布料上能看到白色可口可乐手写体标志的一部分。
它已由美国公司 PSA 完成评级，并被封存在塑料评级盒中，获得了该公司的最高等级 Gem Mint 10。
车迷们立刻发现了这个标志。“他们从哪儿弄到他的赛车服的？”帖子下一位评论者问道。“天哪，这太酷了，”另一个人评论道，还有人补充说：“哈哈哈可口可乐想回西班牙看看因为可口可乐瓶子引发的混乱。可口可乐，来当 LN4 Fusion 的赞助商吧！”
在新建的马德里赛道举行的西班牙大奖赛之后，诺里斯在冷却室里的一幕让他迅速走红。当时似乎有人要求诺里斯放下他正在喝的可口可乐，但他拒绝了。“我刚跑完一场比赛，所以我有权喝我想喝的东西。非常感谢，”诺里斯当时说道。
这一幕在网上引发了轩然大波，因为可口可乐的竞争对手百事公司是F1的官方合作伙伴。
在得克萨斯州奥斯汀接受媒体采访时，诺里斯被进一步追问此事。“没有，之后没人再跟我说过什么。我觉得比赛结束后我们应该被允许喝任何我们想喝的东西，尤其是当你在车里待了两个小时的时候。
“这已经是一些最炎热的比赛了，赛车也很难驾驶，所以我觉得我应该被允许喝我想喝的东西。”
他补充道：“从车队角度来说，车队可能比我受到更多责备。因此我们用来装饮料的杯架很小，所以没有品牌标识，但我可以喝任何我能喝的东西。只是他们存在品牌方面的问题。”
“但这不是我需要考虑、或者应该考虑的事情，所以这肯定是一些已经在其他人之间解决掉的事情。我想事情就是这样。只是电视和品牌之类的事情，但我可以喝任何我喜欢的东西。”
Dynasty 是 Topps 生产的最昂贵的 F1 产品。每盒装有一张封装卡，总是带有纪念物的签名卡，且每张都编号为 10 张或更少。当 2024 版于 2025 年 2 月发售时，一盒售价 1,099.99 美元。
这张诺里斯卡片的基础版本限量 10 张，上面还有更稀有的红色、黑色和金色版本。
detailEn: Topps reveals Gem Mint 10 Lando Norris card with Coca-Cola suit patch
The signed 2024 Dynasty card features two race suit relics beneath Norris’s autograph
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.

Topps has shared one of its rarest Lando Norris cards: a signed 2024 Dynasty Formula 1 card with two pieces of race suit, one of them cut from the Coca-Cola logo on the sleeve of his McLaren race suit.
The Topps Racing account posted a short video of the card on Instagram on Friday, with the caption "This Lando Norris patch auto goes CRAZY!"
The card comes from the Single Driver Dual Relic Autograph set. Two windows of red fabric sit below Norris's signature. The left-hand piece shows part of the white Coca-Cola script.
It has been graded by the American company PSA, which sealed it in a plastic case with its highest grade, Gem Mint 10.

Fans spotted the logo straight away. "Where did they get his race suit?" asked one of the commenters under the post. "Omg this is so dope," someone else commented, while another added: "Hahaha Coca-Cola wants to come back to Spain and see the chaos that erupted over the Coca-Cola bottle. Coca-Cola, become a sponsor of LN4 Fusion!"

Norris went viral after the Spanish Grand Prix at the new Madring Circuit during a moment in the cooldown room. Norris was seemingly asked to put down the Coca-Cola he was drinking, but he refused. “I just did a race, so I’m allowed to drink what I would like. Thank you so much,” Norris said at the time.
The moment caused chaos online as PepsiCo, a rival of Coca-Cola, is an official partner of F1.

Norris was pressed further on the situation while speaking to the media in Austin, Texas. “No, no one’s ever said anything to me since. I feel like we should be allowed to drink whatever we want after a race, especially when you’re in it for two hours.
"It’s been some of the hottest races, cars are also difficult to drive, so I feel like I should be allowed to drink what I want.”

He added: “From a team, the team might have been told off more than I was. And therefore we have little holders to put our drinks in, so it’s unbranded, but I’m allowed to drink whatever I can. It’s just the branding issues that they have.

"But this is not something I need to be thinking of, or I should be thinking of, so it’s some stuff I’m sure that was cleared up between other people. That’s simply all it was I think. It’s just TV and branding and all of those things, but I can drink whatever I like.”

Dynasty is the most expensive F1 product Topps makes. Each box holds a single encased card, always an autograph with a relic, and every one is numbered to 10 copies or fewer. When the 2024 edition went on sale in February 2025, a box cost $1,099.99.
The base version of this Norris card is limited to 10 copies, with rarer red, black and gold versions on top.

2026年一级方程式冠军基米·安东内利已将红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘选为最有可能阻碍他2027年卫冕的车手
在系列赛中仅第二个赛季，梅赛德斯车手在墨西哥大奖赛上成为了F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军，当时年仅20岁68天，也是自1953年阿尔贝托·阿斯卡里以来首位赢得冠军的意大利人。
但在周四在圣马力诺举行的新闻发布会上，安东内利明确表示，他预计下个赛季的竞争将更加激烈，并指出了四次冠军得主是他的主要对手。
“如果我要选择一个车手，我会说马克斯——他可能是造成最多问题的那个人，”安东内利用意大利语说。
维斯塔潘以两分的差距错过了2025年的冠军，落后于麦克拉伦的兰多·诺里斯。他赢得了过去五场大奖赛中的三场，以279分排在车手积分榜第二位，落后安东内利111分。
安东内利承认，梅赛德斯在开赛六场大奖赛全部获胜的领先优势已经不复存在。
“去赛道赢得比赛，以证明我们仍然是最好的，这一点非常重要。红牛、麦克拉伦和法拉利已经缩小了差距，我们不再像赛季初期那样统治。我们之间的性能差距更小了，而且从赛道到赛道，力量平衡也可能发生变化，”他说。
“很难说我们能否在预算帽和风洞使用时间限制下重复这样的表现，因为我们已经获胜，这些限制对我们来说现在更低了。”
安东内利欢迎更加激烈的竞争前景。
“当然。赛季的结束已经可以让我们对下一年有所了解。在每个大奖赛上与那些级别的车手竞争对我来说将是一个巨大的挑战，”他说。
这位20岁的年轻人也坚持认为，他的冠军头衔并没有减弱他的渴望。
“尽管赢得了比赛，但我可能比之前更渴望。胜利是一种美好的感觉，也是可以发生在你身上的最好的事情之一。你想要一次次地重温那个时刻，”安东内利说。 “对我来说，这些最后的比赛已经是为2027年的准备，所以目标是好好结束这一年，也许能赢得几场比赛，并尝试在下一年重复它。这只是开始。”
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli names biggest threat to 2027 title defence as he warns Mercedes advantage may fade
The 20-year-old says this season's closing races will help prepare for his 2027 defence
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
2026 Formula 1 champion Kimi Antonelli has chosen Red Bull's Max Verstappen as the driver most likely to stand in the way of his title defence in 2027.

In only his second season in the series, the Mercedes driver became F1's youngest world champion at the Mexican Grand Prix, at the age of 20 years and 68 days, and the first Italian to win the title since Alberto Ascari in 1953.
But speaking at a press conference in San Marino on Thursday, Antonelli made it clear that he expects a much tougher fight next season, and named the four-time champion as his main rival.
"If I had to choose one driver, I'd say Max - he's the one who might cause the most problems," Antonelli said, speaking in Italian.

Verstappen missed out on the 2025 title by just two points to McLaren's Lando Norris. He has won three of the last five grands prix and sits second in the drivers' standings on 279 points, 111 behind Antonelli.
Antonelli admitted that Mercedes' advantage from the opening races, when it won the first six grands prix, has gone.

"It's very important to go to the track and win to show that we're still the best. Red Bull, McLaren and Ferrari have got a lot closer and we're not as dominant as we were at the start of the season. The performance between us is closer, and from track to track the balance of power can change," he said.
"It's difficult to say whether we'll be able to repeat it with the budget cap and the limits on wind tunnel hours, which are lower for us now that we've won."
Antonelli welcomed the prospect of a closer battle.

"Definitely. The end of the season can already give us an idea of what next year could be like. It would be a great challenge for me to have to fight drivers of that calibre at every grand prix," he said.
The 20-year-old also insisted his title had done nothing to dull his appetite.

"Despite the win, I'm maybe even hungrier than before. Winning is a beautiful feeling and one of the best things that can happen to you. You want to relive the moment more and more," Antonelli said. "These last races are already preparation for 2027 for me, so the goal is to finish the year well, maybe with a few wins, and try to repeat it next year. It's only the beginning."
